messages.subject: Call for GSOC2017 project proposals
messages.body_plain:
Dear GSOC mentors, as you may know, the admin applications for GSOC2017 begin next week. Brian Peterson and I will take care of it again, as in previous years.

The amount of project ideas is one of the criteria that the Google folks use to evaluate open-source organizations such as the R project. I have set up a project ideas page on https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/wiki/table-of-proposed-coding-projects and I have already posted a few ideas. If you can post your own ideas in the next two weeks (by Feb 10), we would be grateful, as it would strengthen our admin application.

Thanks in advance, and looking forward to working with you all in another GSOC.

Toby

Thanks!

messages.subject_clean: Clarification regarding project ideas and status: GSoC 2017
messages.body_plain:
It's probably best to take these messages at face value.

"Need mentors" or "need students" means just that, and does not
necessarily imply anything else. Also if you have useful ideas and
energy, it makes sense for a project to try to find a way to bring you
into to team.

My 2 cents.

JN

messages.subject: GSOC Project Idea - Google Firebase & R
messages.subject_clean: GSOC Project Idea - Google Firebase & R
messages.body_plain:
Hallo GSOC community,

After the Google Summer of Code 2016 I invested quite some time to create https://R.Codes , a platform to share R codes/snippets.
During the programming I learned what an amazing noSQL DB Google Firebase is.
After writing some advanced Shiny + HTML tutorials I noticed that R could profit from a DB connection which offers YWT authentication for security that is easily integrated:

The advantage of connecting Google Firebase to R would be that we could easily share data between independend IoT devices and fetch them in R. Other than that It would also allow to make Shiny capable of social logins and to allow each users to upload files and store configurations persistently (which Rstudio now tries but not really succeeds in).

Here a proof of concept of Shiny + Firebase: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fN84C3I79CQ&feature=youtu.be

For now I would like to hear some feedback (whether that is usefull & GSOC material) and in the meantime I get some more people involved with the project (I already opened the github repo: https://github.com/Kohze/FireData )

Greetings,
Robin.

messages.subject: Project idea and looks for mentors
messages.subject_clean: Project idea and looks for mentors
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am an undergraduate student and have a project idea about wrapping the TnT javascript library <https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/article/32/16/2524/1743657/TnT-a-set-of-libraries-for-visualizing-trees-and> in R to provide interactive genomic visualizations (a simple genome browser).
I have already added a wiki page at https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/wiki/Interactive-Genome-Browser-in-R, and you can see my attempt at https://github.com/Marlin-Na/TnT.

According to instructions on the wiki, I am here looking for possible mentors, please see if you are willing to mentor this project.

Thanks !

Jialin
